content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Re-appointment for one year, or until completing 65 years of age, or until regular Specialists are available, whichever is earlier Applicant declares there will be no lien on regular appointment to the post Applicant declares no claim will be made for regularisation in state government service

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested photograph affixed on the form Copy of High School or Higher Secondary certificate as proof of date of birth Copies of educational certificates (MBBS, postgraduate degree/diploma with specialisation) Copy of PPO number document Affidavit that no CBI inquiry, vigilance inquiry, disciplinary proceeding or criminal case is pending Copy of State Medical Council registration certificate; preferential qualification and experience certificates, if any

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIS UP Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application format (pages 5-7 of this notice; also on http://uplabour.gov.in/ESIS and sewayojan.up.nic.in). Fill in the post, specialisation and three preferred places of posting in order of preference. Affix a self-attested photograph and attach the copies and affidavit the form asks for. Send the application by Registered/Speed Post or hand it in directly at the Directorate, ESI Scheme, Labour Medical Services UP, Sarvodaya Nagar, Kanpur. Application must reach by 10-12-2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ESIS UP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIS UP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 45 vacancies: 9 Physician, 8 Surgeon, 7 Ortho. Surgeon, 2 Radiologist, 6 Anesthetist, 2 Chest & T.B Specialist and 3 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIS UP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format on pages 5-7 of this notice; also on http://uplabour.gov.in/ESIS and sewayojan.up.nic.in) and send it to Directorate, Employee's State Insurance Scheme, Labour Medical Services UP, Sarvodaya Nagar, Kanpur, by registered post / speed post, or directly at the directorate, to reach by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pension-based re-appointment terms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired Specialists of ESI Scheme UP / UP Provincial Medical Health Services who are eligible for pension from the state government treasury under the old pension scheme of the UP government; the application form asks for MBBS and postgraduate degree/diploma (with specialisation) details. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired Specialist of ESI Scheme UP or UP Provincial Medical Health Services. Must be eligible for pension from the state government treasury under the old pension scheme of the UP government.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Re-appointment for one year, or until completing 65 years of age, or until regular Specialists are available, whichever is earlier. Applicant declares there will be no lien on regular appointment to the post. Applicant declares no claim will be made for regularisation in state government service.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by ESIS UP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kanpur (Pandunagar, Sarvodayanagar, Kidwainagar, Azadnagar), Naini, Prayagraj, Agra and Aligarh, Modinagar, Saharanpur, Pipri, Renukoot, Sonbhadra.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Self-attested photograph affixed on the form; Copy of High School or Higher Secondary certificate as proof of date of birth; Copies of educational certificates (MBBS, postgraduate degree/diploma with specialisation); Copy of PPO number document; Affidavit that no CBI inquiry, vigilance inquiry, disciplinary proceeding or criminal case is pending; Copy of State Medical Council registration certificate; preferential qualification and experience certificates, if any.
